verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only generic mentions of 'search and filtering on both nodes and edges' and vector/text indexes, with no documentation of range queries, geo filtering, nested boolean logic, or array membership operators in HelixQL. Community comments confirm HelixQL is a bespoke query language but don't clarify filter expressiveness. missing for 10: docs on range/comparison operators, geo/spatial filters, nested AND/OR/NOT boolean composition, and array/IN membership predicates.
